flatVocabParam.name: strain
flatVocabParam.help: Strain or isolate whose coordinate system the returned segment is expressed in. The list is all strains that have indel data loaded.

sqlQuery.name: StrainsByOrganism
sqlQuery.sql: SELECT strain AS internal, strain AS term, strain AS display FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT regexp_replace(pan.name, '_Indel$', '') AS strain FROM (SELECT DISTINCT protocol_app_node_id FROM apidb.indel) x , study.protocolappnode pan WHERE pan.protocol_app_node_id = x.protocol_app_node_id AND pan.name LIKE '%\_Indel' ) t ORDER BY strain
